title: Emergency - ASL Communication Demo
description: A firefighter arrives at a house fire and communicates with a Deaf witness who responds in ASL, translated by SignBridge.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Are you okay? What happened here?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.asl_sentence: A fire broke out fast. There was a loud explosion.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Do you know what caused it? Is anyone inside?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.asl_sentence: A gas leak blew out and destroyed the door.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Is anyone still inside? Do they need help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.asl_sentence: They are blind and need help. Come here!

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: We're on it. How did you get out safely?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.asl_sentence: I was awake, stayed careful, and avoided the fire.
